[{"node":"menu_content108","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Permissions","key":"docs_permissions_menu_content","id":"docs_permissions_menu_content","name":"docs_permissions_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Role permissions","key":"md_role_permissions","id":"role-permissions","name":"md_role_permissions","value":"# Role permissions

What each permission of a **Ren Role** allows. Anything a role doesn't allow can still be done once with a manager's PIN ([Approvals](/Docs/Manager%20Tasks)). People with the ERPNext roles **Restaurant Manager** or **System Manager** have every permission."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Tables and orders","key":"md_tables_and_orders","id":"tables-and-orders","name":"md_tables_and_orders","value":"# Tables and orders

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| Every table of the restaurant | Work every table when no floor, room or table is assigned to the person. If some are, only those. |
| See other people's orders | See orders opened by someone else on the tables they work. |
| Work on other people's orders | Add items, send, split or charge orders someone else opened (with the *Own tables* policy). |
| Transfer orders to another table | **Transfer**. |
| Split orders | **Divide**. |"}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Prices and discounts","key":"md_prices_and_discounts","id":"prices-and-discounts","name":"md_prices_and_discounts","value":"# Prices and discounts

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| Max Discount % | Discounts up to this percentage; above it, a manager's PIN. 100 = any discount. |
| Change prices | Change the rate of a line. |
| Void items sent to the kitchen | Void lines already sent. |
| Void whole orders | Void an order with sent items. |"}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Payments and cash","key":"md_payments_and_cash","id":"payments-and-cash","name":"md_payments_and_cash","value":"# Payments and cash

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| Charge orders | Take payments. Also needs the ERPNext roles *Accounts User* and *Sales Manager* and a POS Profile that lists the person. |
| Open and close the cash register | Open and close their register shift. |
| Open the cash drawer (no sale) | **Open drawer** without a payment. |
| Reprint tickets and receipts | Print bills and receipts again. |"}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Operations","key":"md_operations","id":"operations","name":"md_operations","value":"# Operations

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| Mark items sold out (86) | The **86** button. |
| Manage reservations and waitlist | The host stand. |
| Delivers orders (driver) | Being listed as a driver on dispatch screens. |
| Every production center | Every station's screen without assigning them one by one. |
| Edit the floor plan | The pencil on the floor plan: rooms, tables, stations. |
| Edit menus | The Menu Manager and the item editor. |"}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Approvals","key":"md_approvals","id":"approvals","name":"md_approvals","value":"# Approvals

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| Approve with PIN | Their PIN approves, for anyone at the terminal, the actions their own role allows. |"}},{"node":"markdown107","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Things that are not role permissions","key":"md_things_that_are_not_role_permissions","id":"things-that-are-not-role-permissions","name":"md_things_that_are_not_role_permissions","value":"# Things that are not role permissions

- **Which tables and stations** someone works: their access in [Ren Staff](/Docs/Staff%20and%20Roles).
- **Taking phone orders** (the Delivery button): anyone who works some table at a branch that delivers.
- **Charging** also depends on ERPNext ([POS Profile and charging](/Docs/POS%20Profile#who-can-charge))."}}]}]
